lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in a non-linear grid posterior to the gills, with spatial density increasing toward the mid-flank and decreasing toward the anterior head region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with primary circular spots, forming visible grid nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a strong vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and a shadowed trough on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a high-density distribution of micro-spots, which are significantly smaller and more tightly packed than the macro-spots observed on the lateral flank.
